I have listed the orders and identified the customers: acme, birch, and cobalt. Now I need to get the net balance for each customer using the net_balance tool. I will start with 'acme'.

Finally, I need to get the net balance for 'cobalt'.

I have successfully retrieved the net balance for all three customers: acme (62169 cents), birch (48740 cents), and cobalt (26677 cents). The next step is to record a payout for each customer using record_payout(). I will process them one by one.
